chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) when he decided to march towards Syria [and it is a supplication he supplicated to his Lord when placing his foot in the stirrup:]
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when placing his foot in the stirrup before traveling to Syria?
ai.summary: This supplication, recited by Imam Ali (peace be upon him) upon mounting his camel for the campaign in Syria, reflects the profound integration of spiritual devotion with military leadership in Shia tradition. It underscores the concept of *tawakkul* (trust in God) during times of uncertainty, framing the physical act of departure as a ritualized moment of seeking divine guidance and protection before engaging in the struggle for justice.
